decisions.decision: Use curl/httpx with DuckDuckGo Lite for search_web
decisions.rationale: Zero extra dependencies, zero API keys, tiny memory footprint

decisions.decision: Drop Playwright/Chromium entirely; rely on lightweight HTML text extraction

decisions.decision: Classify list_dir and grep_files as ALLOW in safety.check()
decisions.rationale: Read-only tools provide fluid navigation without confirmation fatigue
